classification.difficultyReason: Link a cosine-rule angle, a straight-line supplement, a height calculation and a true bearing.

content.prompt: Refer to the diagram to answer the following questions.

spec.description: Horizontal P–Q–O base, R vertically above O, outer PR and inner QR. Source schematic proportions retained. One unfilled right-angle square at O.
spec.mathematics: PQ=3.5 km, PR=5.7 km, QR=4.2 km; P,Q,O collinear; OR perpendicular to PO. Point O is a named geometric point and remains labelled.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate $\angle PQR$ and hence $\angle RQO$ to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\cos\angle PQR&=\frac{3.5^2+4.2^2-5.7^2}{2(3.5)(4.2)}\\\angle PQR&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{3.5^2+4.2^2-5.7^2}{2(3.5)(4.2)}\right)\\\angle PQR&\approx95^\circ\end{align*}$$
$P$, $Q$ and $O$ lie on a straight line.
$$\begin{align*}\angle RQO&=180^\circ-\angle PQR\\\angle RQO&\approx85^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the length $OR$, correct to one decimal place.

answer.worked:
Using the unrounded angle from part a:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{OR}{\sin\angle RQO}&=\frac{4.2}{\sin90^\circ}\\OR&=\frac{4.2\sin\angle RQO}{\sin90^\circ}\\OR&\approx4.2\text{ km}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: If $OR$ is North, find the true bearing of $Q$ from $R$

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle QRO&=90^\circ-\angle RQO\\\angle QRO&\approx5^\circ\end{align*}$$
$RQ$ is west of south.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing}&=180^\circ+\angle QRO\\\text{Bearing}&\approx185^\circ\end{align*}$$
